mapper.select: select fbk_id as feedback_id, fbk_type as type, fbk_subject as subject, fbk_description as description, fbk_status as status, fbk_reply as reply, fbk_created_at as created_at, fbk_updated_at as updated_at from t_fbk where fbk_user_id = #{userId} order by fbk_created_at desc, fbk_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into t_fbk (fbk_user_id, fbk_type, fbk_subject, fbk_description, fbk_status, fbk_created_at, fbk_updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{type}, #{subject}, #{description}, 0, now(), now())
